title: Slice run-length encoded values using expanded positions
goal: Repair slice_runs(runs, start, stop). runs is a list of (integer_value, integer_count) pairs. Logically expand each value count times in input order, then return the ordinary Python list slice expanded[start:stop] with unit step. start and stop are integers: negative indices count from the expanded length; out-of-range endpoints are clipped; a normalized start >= stop produces []. Every count must be nonnegative; a negative count raises ValueError even when the requested slice is empty or that run lies outside it. Zero-count runs contribute nothing. Do not allocate the entire expansion: allocate values only for the selected output, since counts may be very large while the slice is small. Return a new list, do not mutate runs or its pairs, and preserve the signature.
constraints: Do not add files, dependencies, or modify tests.
Keep slice_runs and its signature unchanged.

provenance.public_tests: Authored specification examples and diagnostic boundary cases
provenance.hidden_tests: Distinct inputs, bounded explicit-expansion oracle, and small slices of large runs
